text:
nina: Quick draft for tomorrow's microrelease RN — runtime patch for KV-cache eviction bug. Need pin owner, canary plan, and internal blast timing. Draft: https://redwood.internal/drafts/rn-kv-evict. Proposing window: 2026-04-02T02:00Z/2026-04-02T04:00Z (2h).

raj: I can take pin ownership. Question: any Dedicated customers pinned to the old image that need manual migration?

nina: Good q. There's one Dedicated tenant on 23.4.0 — ops flagged them; we'll include a note and manual migration play in the RN.

alex: Canary suggestion: 5% for 20m -> 25% for 20m -> full. Monitor: error-rate, median p95 latency, and tokens/sec. Rollback if error-rate >3% sustained for 5m or p95 latency +30% vs baseline.

deploy-bot: /deploy dry-run --image=rwinf-23.4.2-kvec --canary=5 --canary-stage=20m,25m --window=2026-04-02T02:00Z/2026-04-02T04:00Z --pin=on
Dry-run: passed preflight checks.
ID: db-9001-dryrun

ops-bot: infra-check: capacity OK in us-west-2, eu-west-1 has limited spare gpus (note in RN).

nina: Adding short "what changed" bullets and an exec summary to the RN. Also adding "embargo note" for EU legal review until T-6h.

raj: I'll run the canary and own the pin ramp. On-call during window: laura. Laura, able to be on-call?

laura: Yep, I'll be on-call. I'll keep the per-route latency and the per-customer SLA dashboard up. If anything odd, I'll hit manual hold and ping #eng-oncall.

alex: Please include commands in RN ops section. Suggest copy:
```
# schedule
/deploy schedule --image=rwinf-23.4.2-kvec --canary=5 --canary-duration=20m --window=2026-04-02T02:00Z/2026-04-02T04:00Z --pin=on
# rollback
/deploy rollback db-9002 --to-image=rwinf-23.4.1
```
Also include console pin path and Dedicated migration steps.

deploy-bot: /deploy schedule --image=rwinf-23.4.2-kvec --canary=5 --canary-duration=20m --window=2026-04-02T02:00Z/2026-04-02T04:00Z --pin=on
Status: queued
ID: db-9002

nina: Thanks — I'll publish the internal RN at T-3h. Final ask: objections to the 02:00-04:00 UTC window?

raj: No objections. +1

laura: +1. Minor note: call out potential 10% latency variance during steady-state for a subset of kernels.

nina: Noted and added. Will attach monitoring links and the Dedicated migration checklist. Publishing plan set for 23:00 UTC tonight (T-3h).

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: RN publish at 2026-04-01T23:00Z. Auto-check: image-signature OK, license scan OK.

nina: Closing thread — will post RN and the pinned Console entry, and will update with canary metrics during rollout. :memo:
